title: Chapter 321: The Wine Swallowing Boy
content:
Chapter 321: The Wine Swallowing Boy

On the tenth day in this world, Zhong Yu got up and left this mountain village.

That's right, the mountain village that Zhong Yu arrived at first is called Shanxia Village, which is worthy of the name, a village located at the foot of the mountain.

However, Zhong Yu didn't leave forever, but went towards the hills next to Shanxia Village, entered the mountains and dense forests, and pursued his goal.

Since ancient times, those who have achieved great things must have a name if they want to conquer the world.

Regardless of whether you have a bad reputation, a good reputation or a prestigious reputation, you must first have a reputation to let the world know that there is someone like you.

Only in this way will people come to join you, and if you occupy a territory, you will not be despised by others.

Just like Liu Bei in the Three Kingdoms period, he was displaced for most of his life, and he was chased away like a bereaved dog, running around.

But he has the reputation of benevolence and righteousness, and he is an orthodox emperor uncle of the Han Dynasty. He was born with the reputation of righteousness. The whole world knows that there is such a number one person as Liu Huangshu.

So no matter how miserable he is, as long as he can escape to a safer and more stable place, there will be a steady stream of people coming to seek refuge, and Liu Bei can use this to quickly regroup.

As for Zhong Yu, when he first came to this world, what he lacked was such a title.

If Zhong Yu had tens of thousands of troops under his command before, and directly relied on his absolute strength to suppress everything, then naturally he would not care about his reputation, as long as his strength came, everything would come naturally.

Just like in the world of Mingyue in the Qin Dynasty, the power of Yuguo makes everyone in the world feel awe, and there are a steady stream of people who come to join in, making Yuguo stronger and stronger.

But today's Zhong Yu naturally does not have this condition.

He was seriously injured all over his body, and his strength was extremely weak. The communication with his own world had long been broken and extremely weak, and he could only have a little sense of it.

Under such a condition, it is unrealistic to think about crossing countless space barriers and bringing 5,000 troops from your own small world here.

So Zhong Yu now needs a status, a status that makes people feel awe, and thus generates following in his heart.

And the best way to gain such a reputation is one word, kill.

Of course, just killing some ordinary people will not have the slightest effect. If you want to kill, you must kill some strong people.

Killing a strong person also depends on the target. If it is some human beings, every strong person basically has a force to rely on.

So if you kill the wrong person, it is easy to attract the old one to do it, and the old one will attract a large number of people to beat up, and then punch the old master to death.

Zhong Yu's methods are infinitely varied, and there is nothing he can do if he can't use them.

So his best targets are scattered ghosts similar to those monsters.

These monsters are extremely scattered, and they are vigilant and hostile to each other, and it is impossible to unite together.

So if you kill them, you will not face the danger of gang fights.

Moreover, the demon is a disaster for the neighbors, feared by the villagers in the surrounding villages, and deeply hated.

If these evil monsters can finally be killed, they will definitely gain the gratitude and admiration from the bottom of their hearts.

In this way, we can lay a solid public foundation for accepting this region in the future.

The lords of those villagers were not as kind as Zhong Yu.

Although they were not afraid of those monsters, they didn't have any extra thoughts to exterminate them, which wasted their own strength in vain.

Because if you encounter a hard idea on the way to encircle and suppress demons, you will lose too much strength. Then the family to which one belongs is very likely to be destroyed by the enemy, and the loss outweighs the gain.

So those lords have always let go of the monsters. As long as they don't go too far, they will kill a dozen or so villagers in a year.

Of course, those monsters who want to slaughter the village, no matter how unwilling the lord is, will definitely send troops to exterminate them, which has already threatened the foundation of the lord's rule.

Moreover, after killing the demon, Zhong Yu's reputation of bravery can be spread quickly through the word of mouth of the villagers.

By this time, his fame has also reached.

With a reputation, there is a certain amount of gratitude in the hearts of the people. With these two most important points, Zhong Yu can pull the banner at any time and set up his own banner.

Therefore, Zhong Yu asked many villagers in the village, where are the monsters in the evil village around, and then he was going to exterminate them.

At first, when the villagers heard what Zhong Yu meant, they were shocked and tried to dissuade them.

After all, all the guardians of their village have been killed now. If they finally leave and there are monsters coming to make trouble, then they will have no one to protect them.

The news of the village being harassed by demons had long been reported by the middle-aged man in the village to their superior lord, that is, the Dongping family.

But for some reason, the Dongping family, who were supposed to quickly send warriors to take over as the guardians of the village, hadn't made any movement for nearly ten days, as if they didn't know anything about this place.

This kind of silence made the villagers in the village feel scared, and they became more and more dependent on Zhong Yu, a strong man.

Now that they heard that Zhong Yu wanted to leave, out of fear for their own lives, how could they agree. And regarding Zhong Yu's safety, as their savior, he was also worried to a certain extent.

Among them, the most worried and unwilling to give up is the woman Kamiko.

Because of Zhong Yu's protection before, although many people in the village coveted her, they did not dare to take any action. On the contrary, she was quite respectful, even more respectful than when her husband was around.

Now that Zhong Yu is about to leave, he is the first one who feels the crisis. He Meizi is not only afraid that he will never return, but even more afraid that Zhong Yu will be in the hands of those monsters. At that time, their family will really have nothing to rely on.

The fate that followed was dire.

However, Zhong Yu's intention to go has already been decided, so how can these villagers stop him. And he also made it clear to them that he was only going out for a day or two.

After destroying the demons, they will return, not really leaving the village.

Therefore, although the villagers are helpless, they can only tell Zhong Yu where the monsters are raging, and let him go to exterminate them and spread their reputation.

After leaving the village, Zhong Yu climbed over three or four hills and drove for more than a day, and came to a rather dark forest.

Weeds are luxuriant in the woods, animals are rampant, and poisonous snakes and beasts can be seen from time to time.

And next to the deep forest is a small village.

The scale of this small village is much larger than that of Shanxia Village. There are more than 50 houses and a population of more than 200 people. It can be regarded as a big village.

In the deep forest, there is an island-specific monster named Tunjiu Boy.
